findings.description: Array.some/every skip holes. Outer missing row crashes predecessor access; missing breadth is accepted because undefined comparisons and NaN tolerance checks do not reject.
findings.reproduction: Generate valid v4 frame; delete frame.armSections[1] OR delete frame.armSections[1][1]; call projectedLimbSections and static/motion builders.
findings.requiredCorrection: Validate every own outer index and all three own numeric row entries densely before predecessor/max checks; malformed optional controls must return null and render finite fallback without DTO mutation. Add outer and inner sparse cases for both arm/leg and front/side/all movement modes.
findings.qualification: Raw DTO boundary; normal generated records are dense. JSON serialization converts array holes to null, which existing rejection handles, so this does not establish malformed saved JSON acceptance.

pixelObservations: Valid v4 rows visibly alter side/front widths and articulated regional limb shape; normal 77-inch/308-pound examples remain coherent with attached wrists and shorts.
62-inch/650-pound stress remains exaggerated with tissue/garment overlap, consistent with explicitly open engineering-envelope craft limitations.
Body/head materials and proportions remain stylized; inspection is four original captures, not all twelve.

Full appearance craft, empirical calibration, all-suite, current 30-year career qualification and release are not accepted.
